Three ways to read. No need to rush.

Flow presents one word at a time around a fixed point. Bold beginnings emphasizes the start of each word. Classic keeps the original text. A faster pace does not necessarily mean better understanding. Pause to reflect and slow down for unfamiliar material.

Switching to Bold beginnings or Classic shows the full text. Flow remembers its word position. Editing text resets that reading’s position and bookmarks.

Your readings and backups may contain private information. Keep exported backups somewhere you trust. This app does not upload your library or include analytics. Clearing browser data removes the local library; installed apps and browser tabs may use separate storage.

Flow 1.0 · Made for a calmer kind of reading.

A home for your reading.

Open Flow in your usual browser, sign in if asked, and wait for Ready offline before going offline.

  • iPhone & iPad: In Safari, open Share → Add to Home Screen. Choose “Open as Web App” if shown.
  • Mac: In Safari, choose File → Add to Dock.
  • Chrome & Edge: Use the install icon in the address bar or the browser’s app installation menu.

Visit the installed app once while online so it can prepare its offline files. Export and restore your library if it does not carry over from your browser. Installation options depend on browser and operating-system support.

Delete this reading?

This removes its text, progress, and bookmarks from this device. Export a backup first if you want to keep a copy.
